items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Adelaide Hall I think I believe.

ctx.x: I heard him hear when I was playing piano & just starting on the guitar. And he used to come to a little spot in the basement. And James P. Johnson, Tremble & Chisholm some guy named Chisholm... and they all used to melt up there for a cutting session, they called it. And I used to go up there listening, and I called myself a piano player. But I had never met him, I never said anything to him, or nothin'. I just sat around listening.

And these cats when I got thru playing I'd say "what the hell am I doin' even looking at a piano?" But at that time I had been looking for something else to start with. That's where the guitar came in. So I had heard him first, but I didn't know him. He was with playing with this Adelaide something... Adelaide Hall I think I believe. Whoever it was, that introduced him into New York. And everybody was on his tail. All the piano players was on his case. You know, when they find a new cat come town, that can play,…
Did you rely on sheet music at all?
